trigger.summary: Repository evidence contradicted the assumed ownership of orientation filtering.

observation.failure_or_risk: Continuing with the original plan would place query logic in the view instead of the repository/service boundary.
unsupported_assumptions: The view layer owns search parameter serialization.

causes.summary: The initial plan was formed before repository architecture evidence was loaded.

corrections.summary: Replan the change so the view emits domain state and the service/repository serializes the query.
